$Comment: Left click (Primary) held: aim the Compactor and compact. Arrakis_Compactor_Compact is the vanilla Charging interaction with one addition: every tick of the hold compacts the sand block under the crosshair (CompactorInteraction). Rule and numbers are data: blocks whose Group is in AllowedGroups, except ExcludedBlocks and ExcludedPrefixes; Range 3; one cycle takes CompactSeconds and gives DropsPerCycle drops; PowerPerSecond is Mana per second; MaxCrack is the share of the block health shown cracked at the end of a cycle (at most 0.9).
